name: admin-capability-lockdown
description: Organization control mod: withholds the http and process nouns from $ so no plugin beneath it can reach the network or spawn processes, refuses user-tier plugins by name allowlist or by the $ calls their source declares, and withholds the Bash tool (shellPolicy "deny", default) or, in "guardrail" mode, denies well-known network clients as a bypassable speed bump. Hooks engine.create, plugin.register and tool.call; seat it in the managed prepend tier.
author: claude-code-templates

allowedPlugins.title: Allowed plugins
allowedPlugins.description: Comma-separated plugin names that may register; empty allows any name

refuseCalls.title: Refused $ calls
refuseCalls.description: Comma-separated $ calls (or noun prefixes ending in a dot) a user plugin may not make; default: http. and process.

shellPolicy.title: Shell policy
shellPolicy.description: deny withholds the Bash tool; guardrail denies known network clients (bypassable); allow leaves Bash alone

name: websearch-to-exa
description: Overrides the built-in WebSearch tool and routes queries to the Exa search API through $.http.fetch, answering in WebSearch's own result shape, with automatic fallback to the built-in search. A tool.call hook that replaces a core tool.
author: claude-code-templates

exaApiKey.title: Exa API key
exaApiKey.description: Your Exa API key; with none set, the built-in WebSearch runs

numResults.title: Results per query
numResults.description: How many Exa results to return

name: universal-audit-log
description: One hook on * that records every event on $ (tool calls, prompts, turns, other plugins' fs/http/process calls) as JSON lines with origin plugin and tier, duration and outcome, including denials. Buffered and flushed to a JSONL file through $.fs at the end of every turn.
author: claude-code-templates

path.title: Log file
path.description: JSONL file the audit lines are written to, relative to the working directory

skipEvents.title: Skipped events
skipEvents.description: Comma-separated events not to record (default: render and log chatter)

flushEvery.title: Flush every
flushEvery.description: Write the buffered lines after this many events

maxBytes.title: Max file size
maxBytes.description: Keep the file under this many bytes, dropping the oldest lines

name: aitmpl
description: /aitmpl opens a component browser above the prompt: the aitmpl.com catalog (agents, commands, MCPs, settings, hooks, skills, loops, mods, templates) read live from the site's public JSON through $.http.fetch. Pick a type, filter, page, open a component and install it from there ($.process.run with the CLI's argv, no shell) or drop its install command into the prompt. Hooks session.start, command.run and ui.render on AbovePrompt; browsing costs no tokens.
author: claude-code-templates

siteUrl.title: Site URL
siteUrl.description: The site whose public catalog JSON is browsed (counts.json, components/{type}.json)

pageSize.title: Rows per page
pageSize.description: Components listed per page, capped by the rows the band has

name: npm-to-pnpm-rewriter
description: Rewrites npm and npx invocations to pnpm (or yarn / bun) before the Bash tool runs them and tells the model what ran through context. A tool.call hook that forwards a modified event (the modifying placement).
author: claude-code-templates

manager.title: Package manager
manager.description: The package manager npm and npx calls are rewritten to

name: webfetch-cache
description: Short-circuits repeated WebFetch calls for the same URL and prompt within a session, answering { result } from cache without a network round trip. A tool.call hook with TTL and size limits.
author: claude-code-templates

ttlSeconds.title: TTL (seconds)
ttlSeconds.description: How long a cached WebFetch result stays fresh

maxEntries.title: Max entries
maxEntries.description: How many URL + prompt pairs to keep

name: block-destructive-commands
description: Denies Bash commands that match destructive patterns (recursive rm on roots, force push, hard reset, destructive SQL, disk formatting) before they run. A tool.call hook with a Bash matcher that returns { deny } without calling next.
author: claude-code-templates

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Comma-separated regex sources to deny on top of the built-in rules, e.g. \bkubectl\s+delete\b

name: large-edit-confirmation
description: Asks the user, in the engine's AskUserQuestion dialog ($.ui.ask), before Claude edits or overwrites a file larger than a configurable line count; denies by default when nobody can answer (headless runs). A tool.call hook on Edit and Write using $.fs.read.
author: claude-code-templates

maxLines.title: Line threshold
maxLines.description: Files above this many lines need the user's confirmation before an Edit or Write

headless.title: Headless behaviour
headless.description: What to do when nobody can answer (claude -p)

name: protected-paths-guard
description: Denies Edit, Write and NotebookEdit calls on sensitive paths (.env files, lockfiles, CI workflows, git internals, private keys) with a glob allowlist override. A tool.call hook with an array matcher.
author: claude-code-templates

protect.title: Extra protected globs
protect.description: Comma-separated globs to protect on top of the defaults

allow.title: Always-allowed globs
allow.description: Comma-separated globs that are always allowed (checked first)

name: secret-redactor
description: Redacts API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and connection strings from every tool result before the model reads them, notes the redaction through context, and refuses to echo a redacted placeholder back into a Bash command. A tool.call hook in the after placement.
author: claude-code-templates

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Comma-separated regex sources to redact on top of the built-in credential patterns

name: tool-timing-badge
description: Times every tool call and wraps the engine's ToolUse rendering with a colored duration badge from the surface's own element table, on the terminal, Desktop and mobile. Hooks tool.call and ui.render using JSX.
author: claude-code-templates

slowMs.title: Slow threshold (ms)
slowMs.description: Calls at or above this are red, above a quarter of it yellow
